query:
UPDATE email_links
        SET is_sync_active = FALSE,
            sync_paused_at = COALESCE(sync_paused_at, NOW()),
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = $1
          AND deleting_at IS NULL
          AND (sync_paused_at IS NOT NULL OR (is_sync_active AND last_active_at < $2))
        RETURNING id
